items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: he went to a Gatemouth Brown concert... and he saw him play guitar

ctx.x: And I challenge you to tell me what his original instrument was. He was a pianist. And if — they’re hard to find, but if you find that Johnny “Guitar” Watson, before it was Guitar Watson, Little Johnny Watson, whatever, piano trio recordings, he’s singing “Witchcraft,” “Willow Weep for Me,” “I Cried for You,” a beautiful tune called “When Did You Leave Heaven.” I mean unbelievable. And it’s like these recordings should be used as classroom materials to teach young drummers and bass players how to play behind a…

Well you just said playing a little sloppy without being pretentious. And I can see how that would be difficult for a musician who might say, “I want to move to New Orleans and get in the music scene.”
